001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.json;
002
003import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
004import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
005import com.streamconverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
006import com.streamconverter.path.IPath;
007import java.io.BufferedReader;
008import java.io.IOException;
009import java.io.InputStream;
010import java.io.InputStreamReader;
011import java.io.OutputStream;
012import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
013import java.io.Writer;
014import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
015import java.util.Arrays;
016import java.util.List;
017
018/**
019 * JSON Filter Command Class
020 *
021 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from JSON using TreePath expressions. Unlike
022 * JsonNavigateCommand which applies transformations, JsonFilterCommand only extracts/filters data
023 * based on specified paths without any modifications.
024 *
025 * <p>Features: - Extract specific elements using TreePath expressions - Preserve exact data types
026 * and structure of extracted elements - Memory-efficient processing for large JSON files - Support
027 * for simple path expressions
028 */
029public class JsonFilterCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
030
031  private static final int BUFFER_SIZE = 8192; // 8KB buffer for streaming
032  private static final int MAX_MEMORY_BUFFER = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB max buffer
033
034  private final IPath<List<String>> jsonPath;
035  private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;
036
037  /**
038   * Constructor for JSON filtering with typed TreePath selector.
039   *
040   * @param jsonPath the typed TreePath to extract data
041   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jsonPath is null
042   */
043  private JsonFilterCommand(IPath<List<String>> jsonPath) {
044    this.jsonPath = jsonPath;
045    this.objectMapper = new ObjectMapper();
046  }
047
048  /**
049   * Factory method for JSON filtering with typed path selector.
050   *
051   * @param jsonPath the typed path to extract data
052   * @return a JsonFilterCommand instance
053   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jsonPath is null
054   */
055  public static JsonFilterCommand create(IPath<List<String>> jsonPath) {
056    if (jsonPath == null) {
057      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
058    }
059    return new JsonFilterCommand(jsonPath);
060  }
061
062  @Override
063  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
064    try (BufferedReader reader =
065            new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
066        Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
067
068      // Read JSON content efficiently
069      String jsonContent = readJsonContent(reader);
070
071      if (jsonContent.trim().isEmpty()) {
072        writer.write("null");
073        writer.flush();
074        return;
075      }
076
077      try {
078        // Apply simple TreePath-like extraction using lightweight parsing
079        String result = extractJsonValue(jsonContent, jsonPath.toString());
080        writer.write(result);
081        writer.flush();
082
083      } catch (Exception e) {
084        // If extraction fails, return null
085        writer.write("null");
086        writer.flush();
087      }
088    }
089  }
090
091  /**
092   * Read JSON content from reader with memory management
093   *
094   * @param reader the BufferedReader to read from
095   * @return JSON content as string, or empty string if no content
096   * @throws IOException if reading fails
097   */
098  private String readJsonContent(BufferedReader reader) throws IOException {
099    StringBuilder jsonBuilder = new StringBuilder();
100    char[] buffer = new char[BUFFER_SIZE];
101    int totalCharsRead = 0;
102    int charsRead;
103
104    while ((charsRead = reader.read(buffer)) != -1) {
105      totalCharsRead += charsRead;
106
107      // Memory protection: prevent reading excessively large JSON into memory
108      if (totalCharsRead > MAX_MEMORY_BUFFER) {
109        throw new IOException(
110            "JSON content too large for filtering. Use streaming NavigateCommand instead.");
111      }
112
113      jsonBuilder.append(buffer, 0, charsRead);
114    }
115
116    return jsonBuilder.toString(); // Return empty string instead of null
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Extract JSON value using simple TreePath-like expressions
121   *
122   * @param jsonContent the JSON content string
123   * @param path the TreePath expression (simplified)
124   * @return extracted value as JSON string
125   */
126  private String extractJsonValue(String jsonContent, String path) {
127    try {
128      JsonNode rootNode = objectMapper.readTree(jsonContent);
129
130      // Handle root path
131      if ("$".equals(path)) {
132        return objectMapper.writeValueAsString(rootNode);
133      }
134
135      // Handle special case of $[*].property (root array with wildcard)
136      if (path.startsWith("$[*].") && path.length() > 5) {
137        String propertyPath = path.substring(5); // Remove "$[*]."
138        if (rootNode.isArray()) {
139          StringBuilder resultBuilder = new StringBuilder("[");
140          boolean first = true;
141          for (JsonNode arrayElement : rootNode) {
142            if (!first) resultBuilder.append(",");
143            first = false;
144
145            // Apply the property path to each array element
146            String[] propertySegments = propertyPath.split("\\.");
147            JsonNode extractedNode = arrayElement;
148            for (String segment : propertySegments) {
149              if (segment.isEmpty()) continue;
150              extractedNode = extractedNode.get(segment);
151              if (extractedNode == null) {
152                extractedNode = objectMapper.getNodeFactory().nullNode();
153                break;
154              }
155            }
156            resultBuilder.append(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(extractedNode));
157          }
158          resultBuilder.append("]");
159          return resultBuilder.toString();
160        } else {
161          return "null";
162        }
163      }
164
165      // Remove the '$.' prefix if present
166      String normalizedPath = path.startsWith("$.") ? path.substring(2) : path;
167
168      // Navigate through the path
169      JsonNode currentNode = rootNode;
170      String[] pathSegments = normalizedPath.split("\\.");
171
172      for (String segment : pathSegments) {
173        if (segment.isEmpty()) continue;
174
175        // Handle array indexing (e.g., "users[0]")
176        if (segment.contains("[") && segment.endsWith("]")) {
177          String fieldName = segment.substring(0, segment.indexOf("["));
178          String indexStr = segment.substring(segment.indexOf("[") + 1, segment.indexOf("]"));
179
180          if (!fieldName.isEmpty()) {
181            currentNode = currentNode.get(fieldName);
182            if (currentNode == null) return "null";
183          }
184
185          // Handle wildcard array access [*]
186          if ("*".equals(indexStr)) {
187            if (currentNode.isArray()) {
188              // For wildcard, we need to handle subsequent path segments differently
189              // This is a simplified implementation that extracts all matching elements
190              StringBuilder resultBuilder = new StringBuilder("[");
191              boolean first = true;
192              for (JsonNode arrayElement : currentNode) {
193                if (!first) resultBuilder.append(",");
194                first = false;
195
196                // If there are more path segments, apply them to each array element
197                String remainingPath =
198                    String.join(
199                        ".",
200                        Arrays.copyOfRange(
201                            pathSegments,
202                            Arrays.asList(pathSegments).indexOf(segment) + 1,
203                            pathSegments.length));
204                if (!remainingPath.isEmpty()) {
205                  JsonNode extractedNode = arrayElement;
206                  String[] remainingSegments = remainingPath.split("\\.");
207                  for (String remainingSeg : remainingSegments) {
208                    if (remainingSeg.isEmpty()) continue;
209                    extractedNode = extractedNode.get(remainingSeg);
210                    if (extractedNode == null) {
211                      extractedNode = objectMapper.getNodeFactory().nullNode();
212                      break;
213                    }
214                  }
215                  resultBuilder.append(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(extractedNode));
216                } else {
217                  resultBuilder.append(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(arrayElement));
218                }
219              }
220              resultBuilder.append("]");
221              return resultBuilder.toString();
222            } else {
223              return "null";
224            }
225          } else {
226            // Regular array indexing
227            try {
228              int index = Integer.parseInt(indexStr);
229              if (currentNode.isArray() && index >= 0 && index < currentNode.size()) {
230                currentNode = currentNode.get(index);
231              } else {
232                return "null";
233              }
234            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
235              return "null";
236            }
237          }
238        } else {
239          // Simple property access
240          currentNode = currentNode.get(segment);
241          if (currentNode == null) {
242            return "null";
243          }
244        }
245      }
246
247      return objectMapper.writeValueAsString(currentNode);
248    } catch (Exception e) {
249      // If JSON parsing fails, fall back to simple string-based extraction
250      return extractSimplePropertyFallback(jsonContent, path);
251    }
252  }
253
254  /**
255   * Fallback method for simple string-based extraction when JSON parsing fails
256   *
257   * @param jsonContent the JSON content string
258   * @param path the TreePath expression
259   * @return extracted value as JSON string or original content
260   */
261  private String extractSimplePropertyFallback(String jsonContent, String path) {
262    // Handle root path
263    if ("$".equals(path)) {
264      return jsonContent.trim();
265    }
266
267    // Simple property extraction: $.property
268    if (path.startsWith("$.") && !path.contains("[") && path.indexOf(".", 2) == -1) {
269      String property = path.substring(2);
270      return extractSimpleProperty(jsonContent, property);
271    }
272
273    // For other complex paths that couldn't be parsed, return null instead of original content
274    return "null";
275  }
276
277  /**
278   * Extract a simple property from JSON content
279   *
280   * @param jsonContent JSON string
281   * @param property property name to extract
282   * @return property value as JSON string or "null" if not found
283   */
284  private String extractSimpleProperty(String jsonContent, String property) {
285    String searchPattern = "\"" + property + "\":";
286    int propertyStart = jsonContent.indexOf(searchPattern);
287
288    if (propertyStart == -1) {
289      return "null"; // Property not found
290    }
291
292    // Find the start of the value
293    int colonIndex = propertyStart + searchPattern.length();
294    int valueStart = colonIndex;
295    while (valueStart < jsonContent.length()
296        && Character.isWhitespace(jsonContent.charAt(valueStart))) {
297      valueStart++;
298    }
299
300    if (valueStart >= jsonContent.length()) {
301      return "null";
302    }
303
304    // Extract the value based on its type
305    char firstChar = jsonContent.charAt(valueStart);
306
307    if (firstChar == '"') {
308      // String value
309      return extractQuotedString(jsonContent, valueStart);
310    } else if (firstChar == '{') {
311      // Object value
312      return extractJsonObject(jsonContent, valueStart);
313    } else if (firstChar == '[') {
314      // Array value
315      return extractJsonArray(jsonContent, valueStart);
316    } else {
317      // Number, boolean, or null
318      return extractSimpleValue(jsonContent, valueStart);
319    }
320  }
321
322  private String extractQuotedString(String json, int start) {
323    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
324    result.append('"');
325    int i = start + 1; // Skip opening quote
326
327    while (i < json.length()) {
328      char c = json.charAt(i);
329      if (c == '"' && (i == start + 1 || json.charAt(i - 1) != '\\')) {
330        result.append('"');
331        break;
332      }
333      result.append(c);
334      i++;
335    }
336
337    return result.toString();
338  }
339
340  private String extractJsonObject(String json, int start) {
341    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
342    int braceCount = 0;
343
344    for (int i = start; i < json.length(); i++) {
345      char c = json.charAt(i);
346      result.append(c);
347
348      if (c == '{') braceCount++;
349      else if (c == '}') braceCount--;
350
351      if (braceCount == 0) break;
352    }
353
354    return result.toString();
355  }
356
357  private String extractJsonArray(String json, int start) {
358    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
359    int bracketCount = 0;
360
361    for (int i = start; i < json.length(); i++) {
362      char c = json.charAt(i);
363      result.append(c);
364
365      if (c == '[') bracketCount++;
366      else if (c == ']') bracketCount--;
367
368      if (bracketCount == 0) break;
369    }
370
371    return result.toString();
372  }
373
374  private String extractSimpleValue(String json, int start) {
375    StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
376
377    for (int i = start; i < json.length(); i++) {
378      char c = json.charAt(i);
379      if (c == ',' || c == '}' || c == ']' || Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
380        break;
381      }
382      result.append(c);
383    }
384
385    return result.toString();
386  }
387}
